tei:div.tei:p: ༁ྃ: zab chos zhi khro dgongs pa rang grol las: brgya phyag sdig sgrib rang grol zhes bya ba bzhugs so:

kun bzang che mchog zhi khro'i lha tshogs dang : dam pa rigs brgya 'dus pa'i lha tshogs la: gus pas phyag 'tshal sdig sgrib kun byang nas: 'gro kun rnam dag zhing la spyod par shog: dam pa rigs brgya zhi khro rab 'byams la: sdig sgrib sbyang phyir brgya phyag 'tshal ba'i thabs: phyag 'tshal sdig sgrib rang grol 'di bstan gyis: dus gsum kun tu 'di la 'bad par gces: na mo: dang po'i sangs rgyas 'od mi 'gyur ba'i sku: yid shes rnam dag sangs rgyas kun gyi yab: nam mkha'i mdog can mnyam bzhag skyil krung bzhugs: kun bzang chos kyi sku la phyag 'tshal lo: dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad bskyed pa'i yum: chos khams rnam dag dri med shel ltar dkar: bde ba chen pos yab la dgyes par 'khril: yum chen kun tu bzang mor phyag 'tshal lo: seng chen khri steng gti mug ma spangs dag: gzugs phung rnam dag chos dbyings ye shes ngang : dung mdog phyag na 'khor lo dril bu bsnams: sku mchog rnam snang sku la phyag 'tshal lo: glang chen khri steng zhe sdang ma spangs dag: rnam shes rnam dag me long ye shes ngang : mthing mdog phyag na rdo rje dril bu bsnams: thugs mchog rdo rje sems la phyag 'tshal lo: rta mchog khri steng nga rgyal ma spangs dag: tshor ba rnam dag mnyam nyid ye shes ngang : gser mdog phyag na rin chen dril bu bsnams: yon tan rin chen 'byung la phyag 'tshal lo: rma bya'i khri steng 'dod chags ma spangs dag: 'du shes rnam dag sor rtogs ye shes ngang : zangs mdog phyag na padma dril bu bsnams: gsung mchog snang mtha' yas la phyag 'tshal lo: shang shang khri steng phrag dog ma spangs dag: 'du byed rnam dag bya grub ye shes ngang : g.yu mdog phyag na rgya gram dril bu bsnams: phrin las don yod grub la phyag 'tshal lo: nam mkha' rnam dag sangs rgyas rigs kyi yum: zla ba'i mdog 'dra 'khor lo dril 'dzin ma: bde ba chen pos yab la dgyes par 'khril:

yum chen dbyings phyug ma la phyag 'tshal lo: sa khams rnam dag rdo rje rigs kyi yum: bai ḍūr mdog 'dra rdo rje dril 'dzin ma: bde ba chen pos yab la dgyes par 'khril: yum chen sangs rgyas spyan la phyag 'tshal lo: chu khams rnam dag rin chen rigs kyi yum: btso ma'i mdog 'dra rin chen dril 'dzin ma: bde ba chen pos yab la dgyes par 'khril: yum chen mā ma kī la phyag 'tshal lo: me khams rnam dag padma rigs kyi yum: me shel mdog 'dra padma dril 'dzin ma: bde ba chen pos yab la dgyes par 'khril: yum chen gos dkar mo la phyag 'tshal lo: rlung khams rnam dag bya grub ye shes yum: ind+ra'i mdog 'dra rgya gram dril 'dzin ma: bde ba chen pos yab la dgyes par 'khril: yum chen dam tshig sgrol la phyag 'tshal lo: mig gi rnam shes ma spangs gnas su dag: gangs ri'i mdog can myu gu dril bu 'dzin: byang chub sems dpa' 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i: sa yi snying po'i zhabs la= rna ba'i rnam shes ma spangs gnas su dag: sprin dkar mdog 'dra klu shing dril bu 'dzin: byang chub sems dpa' 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i: byams pa mai tri'i zhabs la= sna yi rnam shes ma spangs gnas su dag: sbur len mdog 'dra snye ma dril bu 'dzin: byang chub sems dpa' 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i: kun tu bzang po'i zhabs la= lce yi rnam shes ma spangs gnas su dag: gser chen mdog 'dra ral gri dril bu 'dzin: byang chub sems dpa' 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i: nam mkha'i snying po'i zhabs la= lus kyi rnam shes ma spangs gnas su dag: bye ru'i mdog can padma dril bu 'dzin: byang chub sems dpa' 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i: spyan ras gzigs dbang zhabs la= yid kyi rnam shes ma spangs gnas su dag: li khri'i mdog can utpal dril bu 'dzin: byang chub sems dpa' 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i: 'jam dpal gzhon nu'i zhabs la= kun gzhi'i rnam shes ma spangs gnas su dag:

kunda'i mdog can pu ti dril bu 'dzin: byang chub sems dpa' 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i: sgrib pa rnam sel zhabs la= nyon yid rnam shes ma spangs gnas su dag: margad mdog can rdo rje dril bu 'dzin: byang chub sems dpa' 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i: phyag na rdo rje'i zhabs la= gzugs su snang ba ma spangs gnas su dag: chu shel mdog can me long dril bu 'dzin: dus gsum bde gshegs spyan la mchod 'bul ma: lā se dkar mo'i zhabs la= 'das pa'i rtog pa ma spangs gnas su dag: mu tig mdog can pad dkar dril bu 'dzin: dus gsum bde gshegs mchod pas mnyes byed ma: puṣpe dkar mo'i zhabs la= chos can rtog pa ma spangs gnas su dag: gur gum mdog can phreng ba dril bu 'dzin: dus gsum bde gshegs phyag rgyas mnyes byed ma: mā le ser mo'i zhabs la= dri ru snoms pa ma spangs gnas su dag: ratna'i mdog can dri zhim spos phor bsnams: dus gsum bde gshegs shangs la mchod 'bul ma: dhu pe ser mo'i zhabs la= sgra ru grags pa ma spangs gnas su dag: ha lo'i mdog can pi waṃ sgra sgrogs ma: dus gsum bde gshegs snyan la mchod 'bul ma: gīrti dmar mo'i zhabs la= ma 'ongs rtog pa ma spangs gnas su dag: padma'i mdog can snang gsal mar me 'dzin: dus gsum bde gshegs sku la mchod 'bul ma: ā lo dmar mo'i zhabs la= da lta'i rtog pa ma spangs gnas su dag: utpal mdog can dri yi dung phor 'dzin: dus gsum bde gshegs thugs la mchod 'bul ma: ghandhe ljang mo'i zhabs la= ro bro'i rtog pa ma spangs gnas su dag: rgya mtsho'i mdog can bcud ldan zhal zas 'dzin: dus gsum bde gshegs ljags la mchod 'bul ma: nirti ljang mo'i zhabs la= rtag par lta ba ma spangs gnas su dag: sku mdog dkar po dbyug to dril bu 'dzin: khro bo'i gzugs kyis shar sgo'i bar chad srung : rnam par rgyal ba'i zhabs la= chad par lta ba ma spangs gnas su dag:

sku mdog ser po thod dbyug dril bu 'dzin: khro bo'i gzugs kyis lho sgo'i bar chad srung : gshin rje gshed po'i zhabs la= bdag tu lta ba ma spangs gnas su dag: sku mdog dmar po lcags sgrog dril bu 'dzin: khro bo'i gzugs kyis nub sgo'i bar chad srung : rta mgrin rgyal po'i zhabs la= mtshan mar lta ba ma spangs gnas su dag: sku mdog ljang gu rgya gram dril bu 'dzin: khro bo'i gzugs kyis byang sgo'i bar chad srung : bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i zhabs la= snying rje tshad med rigs drug gnas nas 'dren: sku mdog dkar mo 'gugs byed lcags kyu 'dzin: khro bo'i sku la gnyis med dgyes par 'khril: rdo rje lcags kyu ma la= byams pa tshad med 'gro ba'i don mdzad ma: sku mdog ser mo 'ching byed zhags pa 'dzin: khro bo'i sku la gnyis med dgyes par 'khril: rdo rje zhags pa ma la= dga' ba tshad med 'gro ba dang du len: sku mdog dmar mo sdom byed lcags sgrog 'dzin: khro bo'i sku la gnyis med dgyes par 'khril: rdo rje lcags sgrog ma la= btang snyoms tshad med 'gro la nye ring med: sku mdog ljang gu 'bebs byed dril bu 'dzin: khro bo'i sku la gnyis med dgyes par 'khril: rdo rje dril bu ma la= nga rgyal rnam dag lha yi 'jig rten 'dren: sku mdog dkar po sgra snyan pi waṃ 'dzin: sprul sku'i tshul gyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i: lha dbang brgya byin zhabs la= phrag dog rnam dag lha min 'jig rten 'dren: sku mdog ljang gu skyobs byed go mtshon 'dzin: sprul sku'i tshul gyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i: thags bzang ris kyi zhabs la= 'dod chags rnam dag mi yi 'jig rten 'dren: gser mdog phyag na lhung bzed mkhar gsil 'dzin: sprul sku'i tshul gyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i: shākya thub pa'i zhabs la= gti mug rnam dag byol song 'jig rten 'dren: sku mdog mthing ga po ti glegs bam 'dzin:

sprul sku'i tshul gyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i: seng ge rab brtan zhabs la= ser sna rnam dag yi dwags 'jig rten 'dren: sku mdog dmar po rin chen sgrom bu 'dzin: sprul sku'i tshul gyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i: bcom ldan kha 'bar zhabs la= zhe sdang rnam dag dmyal ba'i 'jig rten 'dren: nag po'i phyag na bsil drod me chu 'dzin: sprul sku'i tshul gyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i: chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs la= smug nag zhal gsum phyag drug dkar dmar zhal: rdo rje kha ṭwāṃ rnge'u chung g.yas na 'dzin: dril bu bhan dmar rgyu zhags g.yon na bsnams: che mchog he ru ka la= dmar smug zhal gsum phyag drug dkar dmar zhal: 'khor lo ral gri dgra st+wa g.yas na 'dzin: dril bu bhandha thong gshol g.yon na bsnams: buddha he ru ka la= mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug dkar dmar zhal: rdo rje bhandha dgra st+wa g.yas na 'dzin: dril bu bhandha thong gshol g.yon na bsnams: badzra he ru ka la= ser nag zhal gsum phyag drug dkar dmar zhal: rin chen kha ṭwāṃ be con g.yas na 'dzin: dril bu bhandha tri shul g.yon na bsnams: ratna he ru ka la= dmar nag zhal gsum phyag drug dkar sngo zhal: padma kha ṭwāṃ dbyug to g.yas na 'dzin: dril bu bhandha rnge'u chung g.yon na bsnams: padma he ru ka la= ljang nag zhal gsum phyag drug dkar dmar zhal: ral gri kha ṭwāṃ dbyug to g.yas na 'dzin: dril bu bhandha thong gshol g.yon na bsnams: karma he ru ka la= khro mo dbyings phyug mthing nag rdo rje 'dzin: dmar chen bhandha yab kyi zhal du stob: bde ba chen pos yab la dgyes par 'khril: kro ti shwa ri ma la= bde gshegs dbyings phyug dmar smug 'khor lo 'dzin: dmar chen bhandha yab kyi zhal du stob: bde ba chen pos yab la dgyes par 'khril: buddha kro ti ma la= rdo rje dbyings phyug mthing nag rdo rje 'dzin: dmar chen bhandha yab kyi zhal du stob:

bde ba chen pos yab la dgyes par 'khril: badzra kro ti ma la= rin chen dbyings phyug ser skya rin chen 'khyud: dmar chen bhandha yab kyi zhal du stob: bde ba chen pos yab la dgyes par 'khril: ratna kro ti ma la= padma dbyings phyug dmar skya padma 'khyud: dmar chen bhandha yab kyi zhal du stob: bde ba chen pos yab la dgyes par 'khril: padma kro ti ma la= las kyi dbyings phyug ljang skya rgya gram 'khyud: dmar chen bhandha yab kyi zhal du stob: bde ba chen pos yab la dgyes par 'khril: karma kro ti ma la= khro mo dkar mo zhing chen gdan la 'gying : 'khor ba'i rnam rtog gzhom phyir zhing dbyug 'phyar: ma mo'i gzugs kyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i: shar phyogs kau rī ma la= khro mo ser mo zhing chen gdan la 'gying : thabs shes gnyis su med phyir mda' gzhu 'gengs: ma mo'i gzugs kyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i: lho phyogs tsau rī ma la= khro mo dmar mo zhing chen gdan la 'gying : 'khor ba mi gtong chu srin rgyal mtshan 'dzin: ma mo'i gzugs kyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i: nub phyogs pra mo ha la= khro mo ljang nag zhing chen gdan la 'gying : chos nyid 'gyur med rdo rje bhandha 'dzin: ma mo'i gzugs kyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i: byang phyogs be ta lī la= khro mo dmar ser zhing chen gdan la 'gying : nyon mongs gnas nas 'dren phyir rgyu ma gsol: ma mo'i gzugs kyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i: shar lho puska si la= khro mo ljang nag zhing chen gdan la 'gying : 'khor ba zhal du gsol phyir dung khrag 'thung : ma mo'i gzugs kyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i: lho nub ghasma ri la= khro mo ser skya zhing chen gdan la 'gying : log rtog phral phyir bam ro mgo lus phral: ma mo'i gzugs kyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i: nub byang tsanḍa li la= khro mo mthing nag zhing chen gdan la 'gying : 'khor ba rten dang phral phyir bam chen phral:

ma mo'i gzugs kyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i: byang shar sme sha ni la= smug nag seng ge'i gdong can khar ro thogs: 'khor ba ka nas dag phyir ral pa bsig: phra men gzugs kyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i: sengha mu kha ma la= dmar mo stag gdong lag gnyis thur du bsnol: 'khor ba zhe la gnon phyir 'bru tshugs blta: phra men gzugs kyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i: byā kri mu kha ma la= nag mo wa yi gdong can spu gri phyar: nyon mongs gnas su dag phyir glo snying za: phra men gzugs kyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i: sri la mu kha ma la= mthing nag spyang mo'i mgo can bam ro 'drad: 'khor ba dong nas sprugs phyir 'bru tshugs blta: phra men gzugs kyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i: shwa na mu kha ma la= dkar ser bya rgod mgo can bam ro thogs: dug gsum rtsad nas gcod phyir rgyu ma 'dren: phra men gzugs kyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i: kri ta mu kha ma la= dmar nag kaṅka'i mgo can bam ro khur: 'khor ba dang du len phyir phrag la gzar: phra men gzugs kyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i: kaṅka mu kha ma la= nag mo bya rog gdong can ral gri 'phyar: nyon mongs bsgral zhing gsol phyir dung khrag 'thung : phra men gzugs kyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i: kha khwa mu kha ma la= mthing nag 'ug pa'i gdong can lcags kyu 'dzin: 'khor ba'i log rtog 'dren phyir bhandha thogs: phra men gzugs kyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i: hu lu mu kha ma la= shar sgor rta gdong dkar mo lcags kyu 'dzin: snying rje tshad med 'khor ba gnas nas 'dren: sgo ma'i gzugs kyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i: rta gdong lcags kyu ma la= lho sgor phag gdong ser mo zhags pa 'dzin: byams pa tshad med log rtog 'ching bar byed: sgo ma'i gzugs kyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i: phag gdong zhags pa ma la= nub sgor seng gdong dmar mo lcags sgrog 'dzin: dga' ba tshad med ma rig nyon mongs bsdoms:

sgo ma'i gzugs kyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i: seng gdong lcags sgrog ma la= byang sgor sbrul gdong ljang gu dril bu 'dzin: btang snyoms tshad med dug lnga'i rtog pa 'joms: sgo ma'i gzugs kyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i: sbrul gdong dril bu ma la= chos nyid rnam dag cir yang snang ba yi: srid gsum zhing du sbyor bas g.yang gzhi gsol: stong khams gnas spor nyi zer zhags pa 'phen: spor byed zhags 'phen ma la= rnam rtog nad rnams rtag tu bsal ba'i phyir: nyon mongs lnga sbyong thod khrag mdung thung 'phen: thugs rje thabs mkhas mi rnams gnas su spor: spor byed mdung thung 'phen la= ma rig sems can dbyings la gzud pa'i phyir: stong khams dbang sdud dung khrag thugs kar bskyil: brjid pa'i rol pas stong khams gnas su spor: spor byed dril 'khrol ma la= mdog bzang dkar ser zhi rgyas ldan pa'i sku: 'dod lnga dbang mdzad dung khrag thugs kar bskyil: lha rnams gnas spor rdo rje khyung chen 'dzin: spor byed khyung thogs ma la= mthing nag chen mo rngam pa'i sku mnga' zhing : g.yul chen rab bzlog rdo rje'i skar mda' 'phen: lha min gnas spor dung khrag zhal du gsol: spor byed skar mda' 'phen la= sku mdog dmar nag dbang drag 'dzoms pa'i zhal: phyi nang sgrib gnyis sbyangs nas bde ba'i phyir: rdo rje glog phreng yi dwags gnas su spor: spor byed glog phreng 'dzin la= dkar nag phyed ma zhi drag ldan pa'i sku: gti mug stongs mdzad thod khrag zhal du gsol: byol song gnas spor rdo rje'i glag sha rdeb: spor byed glag sha rdeb la= sku mdog ser nag drag po rgyas pa'i sku: dmyal ba stongs mdzad thod khrag zhal du gsol: dmyal ba'i gnas spor rdo rje ral gri 'dzin: spor byed ral gri 'dzin la= rnal 'byor dkar smug rdo rje bhandha 'dzin: srin mo g.yag mgo ma la= rnal 'byor dkar ser rdo rje padma 'dzin:

tshangs pa sbrul mgo ma la= rnal 'byor dkar ljang rdo rje tri shul 'dzin: lha chen gzig mgo ma la= rnal 'byor dkar sngo rdo rje 'khor lo 'dzin: gtog 'dod sre mong mgo la= rnal 'byor dkar dmar rdo rje mdung thung 'dzin: gzhon nu dred gdong ma la= rnal 'byor dkar mo rdo rje rgyu zhags 'dzin: brgya byin dom mgo ma la= rnal 'byor ser mo rin chen spu gri 'dzin: rdo rje pha waṃ mgo la= rnal 'byor dmar ser rin chen bum pa 'dzin: zhi ba chu srin mgo la= rnal 'byor dmar ser rin chen padma 'dzin: bdud rtsi sdig gdong ma la= rnal 'byor dkar ser rin chen rdo rje 'dzin: zla ba khra mgo ma la= rnal 'byor ser ljang rin chen dbyug to 'dzin: be con wa gdong ma la= rnal 'byor ser nag rin chen thod khrag 'thung : srin mo stag gdong ma la= rnal 'byor dmar ljang padma be con 'dzin: za ba bya rgod mgo la= rnal 'byor dmar mo padma khog chen 'dzin: dga' ba rta gdong ma la= rnal 'byor dmar skya padma dbyug to 'dzin: stobs chen khyung gdong ma la= rnal 'byor dmar mo padma rdo rje 'dzin: srin mo khyi gdong ma la= rnal 'byor dmar mo padma mda' gzhu 'dzin: 'dod pa pu shud mgo la= rnal 'byor dmar ljang padma bum pa 'dzin: nor srung sha ba'i mgo la= rnal 'byor ljang sngon rgya gram ba dan 'dzin: rlung lha spyang mo'i mgo la= rnal 'byor ljang dmar rgya gram gsal shing 'dzin: mi mo skyin gyi mgo la= rnal 'byor ljang nag rgya gram mche zhags 'dzin: phag mo phag gdong ma la= rnal 'byor ljang dmar rgya gram zhing chung 'dzin: rdo rje khwa ta'i mgo la= rnal 'byor ljang nag rgya gram bam chen 'dzin: sna chen glang chen mgo la= rnal 'byor ljang gu rgya gram sbrul zhags 'dzin: chu lha sbrul gdong ma la= sgo ma dkar mo rdo rje lcags kyu 'dzin: rdo rje khu byug mgo la= sgo ma ser mo rin chen zhags pa 'dzin:

rdo rje ra gdong ma la= sgo ma dmar mo padma lcags sgrog 'dzin: rdo rje seng gdong ma la= sgo ma ljang nag rgya gram dril bu 'dzin: rdo rje sbrul gdong ma la phyag 'tshal lo: zhes pa rnal 'byor mched lcam du yod kun: gcer bur phyung ste brkyang phyag gus pas 'tshal: ngag gis tshig dbyangs snyan pos bstod byas nas: yid kyis dus gsum bsags pa'i sdig sgrib rnams: gnong 'gyod tshul gyis brgya phyag gus pas 'tshal: zhi khro'i lha phyag brgya dang bcur longs pa'i: sgrib sbyangs khyad 'phags sdig sgrib rang grol 'di: na raka bskang bshags la sogs gang byed kyang : 'di bzhin byas pas bsod nams tshad las 'das: de phyir brgya phyag 'di la rab tu 'bad: zhi khro dam pa rigs brgya'i brgya phyag sdig sgrib rang grol zhes bya ba 'khor ba ma stongs bar du ma rdzogs so: bar do thos grol gyi cha lag: na raka bskang bshags kyi cha rkyen: zhi khro'i las byang gsum gyi don 'dus: shin tu zab pa bstan pa 'di ni: kun la spel zhing dus gsum du ma chags par brtson par gyis shig: sa ma ya: grub thob karma gling pa'i gter ma'o:
